title: Run HO19 / Renew Run product landscape

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Run Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Show a whole product and selected details together so viewers can connect overall form with material and construction.
strategic_value: The large Renew Run shoe and two detail crops can make the cushioning story easier to inspect.
demonstration: A large shoe overlaps a pale pink-to-blue rectangular field; two smaller detail crops sit at right and an outline Swoosh spans the image.
practical_value: Decide which details deserve their own crops while leaving the main product as the focal point.

content_islands.name: Copy block
content_islands.spec: Place the black product name, supporting line and small Swoosh at upper left on white.

content_islands.name: Main product
content_islands.spec: Let the large diagonal shoe overlap the white area and the colored rectangle.

content_islands.name: Detail crops
content_islands.spec: Place two smaller product views at right over the outline Swoosh; retain the source’s black presentation surround.

reference_purposes.Expression: A large shoe overlaps a pale pink-to-blue rectangular field; two smaller detail crops sit at right and an outline Swoosh spans the image.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying designer account explains that the layouts reconcile existing imagery, different retail formats and digital crops into a consistent campaign.
